easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Long Feng triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
